target_customer: Websites and online stores that want recommendations; later Shopify merchants via a plugin
problem: Small sites could not build Amazon-style people who bought this also bought recommendations; Directed Edge offered them through an API on the site's existing purchase or click data.
business_model: B2B recommendation API and later Shopify app subscription

founders.name: Scott Wheeler
founders.background_notes: TNW 2008 says he earlier did work on desktop search. No education found.

founders.name: Valentin Hussong
founders.background_notes: Named co-founder by The Next Web (Sept 2008) and an ithistory directory entry; not on the YC page.

competitors.name: Amazon
competitors.what: Built-in product recommendations that Directed Edge aimed to offer to other sites

technical_complexity.rationale: Real-time recommendations in milliseconds over millions of data points required an in-house graph database, per TechCrunch 2009, which was hard for a two person team.

defensibility.rationale: Recommendation algorithms were replicable and many e-commerce platforms later built their own; the in-house graph database was a modest technical edge.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition found; the company still runs a Shopify plugin as of the 2026 site footer.

market_need_then: Smaller sites lacked in-house recommendation systems like Amazon's; TechCrunch in 2009 framed recommendations as central to a post-search web, but no spend data was found.

identity.logo: A logo appears on the site; no description found

brand_strength.rationale: A graph theory term used as a B2B API name; no press or community on the brand found.

pivots.from: General recommendation API for any website
pivots.why: Not stated; the current site markets mainly a Shopify plugin, date not found

outcome_analysis: Directed Edge started in Berlin in 2008 as a two person recommendation API company and joined YC Summer 2009 with only a tiny seed investment reported. No acquisition, shutdown or layoffs were found, and its website in 2026 still advertises a Shopify recommendation plugin delivering half a million recommendations per day, suggesting a small, lasting niche business rather than a venture scale outcome.
notes: The $15K YC seed (June 2009) rests on Seedtable alone, an aggregator. The company has no later rounds found. Location conflicts: the YC page says Berlin, VCBacked and ithistory say San Francisco. Crunchbase (via search snippet) also names Wheeler and Hussong as co-founders. Competitor Amazon is dated Aug 2009, around the batch. The pivot to a Shopify plugin is inferred from the site and has no date. Outcome searches found no acquisition, shutdown or layoffs.
